title: Prime Video's Blade Runner 2099 now has a trailer and release date of November 25 - Engadget
summary: This is the first live-action TV show in franchise history, though there was an animated series called Blade Runner: Black Lotus . As the name suggests, Blade Runner 2099 is set 50 years after the sequel film Blade Runner 2049 .
